cases.test: request::request building > substitutes and encodes path params
request::request building > sends arrays with brackets, in either input style
request::request building > parses integers and rejects bad ones

steps.name: purchasely
steps.err:
purchasely env=prod surface=management identity=- key=…T123
{"error":{"code":"USAGE","messages":["--page must be an integer."]}}

steps.name: purchasely
steps.err:
purchasely env=prod surface=management identity=- key=…T123
{"error":{"code":"USAGE","messages":["--group-by must be one of: sdk_version, sdk_running_mode."]}}

cases.test: request::request building > sends the command name and the runner, never the argument values
request::request building > read-only mode refuses a write before the send, and keeps reads and --dry-run

steps.name: purchasely
steps.err:
purchasely env=staging surface=management identity=- key=…T123
{"error":{"code":"REFUSED","messages":["Read-only mode: PURCHASELY_READ_ONLY=1 is set. This command writes, so the CLI sent nothing."]}}

steps.name: purchasely
steps.err:
purchasely env=prod surface=management identity=- key=…T123
{"error":{"code":"REFUSED","messages":["Read-only mode: read_only is true in the config. This command writes, so the CLI sent nothing."]}}
